content.title: How a Chili's turnaround is leading Brinker to a big earnings beat
content.description:
Brinker International (EAT), the parent company of Chili's and Maggiano's, posted fiscal second quarter results that topped estimates and raised its full-year earnings and revenue guidance. Brinker International CEO Kevin Hochman explains what is driving the company's success and its "barbell" pricing strategy.

content.title: EAT Q4 Deep Dive: Menu Upgrades and Operational Discipline Drive Guidance Lift
content.summary: Casual restaurant chain Brinker International (NYSE:EAT) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 6.9% year on year to $1.45 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $5.80 billion at the midpoint came in 0.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.87 per share was 9.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
